maya: Quick alert — after promoting windward-mini-q6 to canary we see a small but steady increase in structured-output rejects on tool-invoke endpoints (~0.45%). Dash: https://dash.internal/runs/5005
ravi: sample traces? is it truncation, encoding, or extra suffix?
ella: grabbed a few failures. pattern is a malformed escaped unicode at the end of streamed chunks. example payload ends with `... \"note\": \"line break:\u202` then next chunk `8\" } ]` -> parse error because `\\u2028` was split across chunks.
maya: repro: stream=true + kv-cache + ~700 token history. ci-bot posted a lightweight reproducer: ```bash
curl -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" -d '{"model":"windward-mini-q6","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long..."}],"tools":[{"id":"append_log","schema":{}}]}'
```
ravi: so root cause is streaming chunk boundary splitting a multi-byte escape sequence. our streaming encoder emits raw UTF-8 slices which can split `\\u` escapes. parser sees invalid escape and returns 400.
ella: mitigation I tested locally: pre-parse join+repair routine that searches for split `\\u` patterns across chunk boundaries and waits for next chunk before validating. snippet: ```python
def repair_stream(chunks):
    buf = ''.join(chunks)
    buf = re.sub(r"\\\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{0,3})$", lambda m: m.group(0) + '00', buf)
    return buf```
ci-bot: test job: https://ci.internal/job/5005/utf8-split-repair (includes unit that simulates `\\u` split at many offsets)
maya: important note: retry-on-parse must be conservative. we saw retries produce duplicate tool effects in one Dedicated customer when the client retried after a 400. we should avoid auto-retry for deterministic 4xx schema errors. ops flagged tenant: skyline-analytics.
ops: confirmed duplicate appends for skyline-analytics (2 occurrences). recommends changing retry policy and adding idempotency_key as a short-term API contract for side-effecting tools.
ravi: plan: (1) runtime: add stream-repair sanitizer that buffers a small tail (max 8 bytes) and coalesces chunk-boundary escapes behind a feature flag (PR ready) (2) engine: adjust streaming encoder to avoid cutting inside `\\u` sequences where possible (longer-term) (3) api: update retry policy to not retry on 4xx parse errors and propose idempotency_key for tools (4) eng-ml: add fuzz tests for multi-byte split scenarios (junit + python)
ella: I've opened test PR: https://git.internal/eng-ml/stream-tests/pull/123 (adds fuzz harness for unicode-escape splits)
ci-bot: runtime sanitize PR: https://git.internal/infra/runtime/pull/342 (feature-flagged)
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: runtime-sanitize-utf8 -> windward cluster at 5005004400, rollout 10% -> 100% in 20m if green
maya: also adding a small unit that simulates back-to-back chunk splits with interleaved kernel debug markers (just in case the two interact). ravi/ella please coordinate on test coverage.
ravi: will add combined test to stream-tests. also logging change: tag parse-failure events with model+quant-mode so we can correlate.
maya: thanks — keep thread as single source. ping me @maya for canary traces or tenant contact.
